description: This source file provides a service class for handling file uploads to storage backends, creating file objects with associated storage metadata, and integrating with a managed files system. It includes methods to upload files, generate unified file IDs, and store files in a managed repository, specifically tailored for use with OpenAI file objects and specified storage backends.
